visual.description: Single-row full-width bar with centered text on a sage/light-green background.
Navigation split into left (SHOP, ABOUT), center (logo/empty on hero), right (ACCOUNT, CART) zones spanning full width.

Hero divided exactly at vertical center: left half is a full-bleed editorial photo, right half is a white/off-white background with abstract blob shapes; oversized MORAL wordmark spans both columns overlapping the split.
Full-width section with a very large serif headline spanning the entire width, mixing upright and italic weights, with small inline product imagery embedded between words.
Left column (~50%) shows product name, size, price, star rating, description, and Add to Cart CTA; right column (~50%) shows product and packaging photography on a light grey background.
Four equally-spaced text badges (Fragrance-Free, Vegan Suitable, Dermatologist Tested, Gentle Formula) in a single horizontal row.
Left-aligned stacked list of clinical result statistics grouped under bold time-based headings.
Left column holds 'It's time to achieve more with less' headline text; right column shows a circular cropped portrait photo with a HYDRATE/BRIGHTEN/RESTORE label and description below it.
Three stacked benefit blocks (HYDRATE, BRIGHTEN, RESTORE), each with a circular portrait, bold label, and body text, all right-aligned while a product image floats in the left half.
Left column contains centered body copy about BRC-5 formula; right column shows floating product bottle imagery on grey.

Left column shows a large numbered ingredient list (Ectoin, Glycoin, Peptides, Prebiotics) in oversized display type; center shows a macro ingredient bubble photography; right column shows a short descriptor text.
Dark tan/brown full-width section split: left has headline and body copy, right shows a split editorial image collage stacked vertically.
A single horizontal scrolling ticker row with repeated text badges separated by icon dividers spanning the full viewport width.
Two equal-width full-bleed editorial photos side by side with no gap, filling the full viewport width.
Sage green full-width section with a very large serif headline mixing italic and roman type spanning the full width.
Four equal-width square editorial/product photos in a single row grid with no visible gap.
Footer on sage background with four columns: INFO links, COMMUNITY links, center MORAL logo mark, and NEWSLETTER signup form with email input.
Bottom footer strip with centered copyright text, payment icons row, and branding credit links all stacked centrally.
